cause_quote: The original worker added `if (serialized.byteLength > SQLITE_WORKER_MAX_RESULT_BYTES) { throw new Error("SQLite worker result exceeds the transport byte limit"); }` and defined that limit as `64 * 1024 * 1024`.
user_saw: A SQLite worker read returned an error whenever the serialized result exceeded 64 MiB.
summary: The fix transfers SQLite worker results larger than 64 MiB in bounded frames and returns the result after complete reassembly.
reasoning: The introducing diff added the SQLite worker and its 64 MiB rejection check together, so oversized reads failed from the first version of the worker API. First-parent history and the intervening acquisition refactor show that the check persisted until this fix, whose PR reproduced the failure by reading three stored 24 MiB values.
